**What changes, and why:**

**The pages it touches:** each seen at 390 px and 1440 px wide, in every theme.

- [ ] `npm run gen`, `npm run lint`, `npm test`, `npm run knip` and `npm run test:screens` pass.
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), as `CONTRIBUTING.md` says.
- [ ] Code work leaves `src/units/<unit>/content/` alone; a change to a lesson cites its source.
- [ ] Text a learner reads follows the writing rules in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
